pending.title: Wombat cube poop
pending.hook: Wombats are the only animals in the world that produce cube-shaped poop
pending.narration: Wombats are the only animals in the world that produce cube-shaped poop. This strange shape prevents their droppings from rolling away, which lets them stack their feces high to mark their territory on rocks and logs. Their intestines have varying elasticity that creates this geometric form as the food digests. It is a bizarre adaptation for an animal that spends most of its life in pitch-black tunnels. Follow for more unusual facts.
pending.caption:
I honestly thought this cube poop fact was an internet joke until I looked it up.

Turns out a wombat intestine changes thickness along its length to squeeze poop into distinct corners. They can drop up to eighty of these little blocks every single night. Researchers found it takes about two weeks for them to fully digest their food. It is wild how evolution solves simple problems in such weird ways.

Have you ever seen a wombat in person?
